final: WITH matched AS (SELECT COALESCE(o.timespan, 'NO_TIMESPAN') as bucket, COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) as cnt FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY COALESCE(o.timespan, 'NO_TIMESPAN')), totals AS (SELECT *, SUM(cnt) OVER () as total, 1.0/COUNT(*) OVER () as avg_share FROM matched), shares AS (SELECT *, CAST(cnt AS REAL)/total as share FROM totals), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess FROM filtered
